verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show uv publishing to and resolving from an internal GitLab package registry, and the docs mention dependency 'alternative sources'. However, nothing documents configuring custom indexes or mirrors, and nothing covers credentials or scoped authentication. missing for 10: documented index/mirror configuration, scoped or per-index authentication mechanisms, credential handling docs, independent corroboration of auth behavior

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can point the manager at private registries or mirrors with scoped authentication

citations.quote: You can also specify version constraints or alternative sources
Several projects share a common wheel on an internal GitLab. They replaced about 10 lines of CI YAML with just "uv build" and "uv publish."
